title: pilosella macrotricha
intro: Pilosella macrotricha, commonly known as Alpine fleabane, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the dandelion family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella macrotricha include its ability to treat conditions such as digestive issues, wounds, and skin irritations, and it is also used as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella macrotricha include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
